# Limpieza 2025

```{r}
# install.packages(c("readxl","dplyr","purrr","janitor","stringr","lubridate","readr"))
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(janitor)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)

# ---------- Config ----------
archivo_2025 <- "data/BD 2025.xlsx"

# columnas objetivo en el orden deseado
cols_final <- c("LOCATION","DATE","CO","NO","NO2","NOX","O3","PM10","PM2.5",
                "PRS","RAINF","RH","SO2","SR","TOUT","WSR","WDR")

# nombres que pueden venir "limpios" tras clean_names()
# mapeo -> nombre final
map_names <- c(
  "date"   = "DATE",
  "co"     = "CO",
  "no"     = "NO",
  "no2"    = "NO2",
  "nox"    = "NOX",
  "o3"     = "O3",
  "pm10"   = "PM10",
  "pm2_5"  = "PM2.5",
  "prs"    = "PRS",
  "rainf"  = "RAINF",
  "rh"     = "RH",
  "so2"    = "SO2",
  "sr"     = "SR",
  "tout"   = "TOUT",
  "wsr"    = "WSR",
  "wdr"    = "WDR"
)

# ---------- Helpers ----------

# 1) Parsear DATE: admite texto en varios formatos o serial de Excel
parse_date_flex <- function(x) {
  # si es numeric: asumir serial Excel
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    return(as.POSIXct(x * 86400, origin = "1899-12-30", tz = "UTC"))
  }
  # si viene como texto:
  xx <- as.character(x)
  xx[xx == ""] <- NA
  out <- suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(
    xx,
    orders = c("Ymd HMS","Y-m-d H:M:S","Y/m/d H:M:S",
               "dmY HMS","d/m/Y H:M:S","m/d/Y H:M:S",
               "Ymd","Y-m-d","Y/m/d","d/m/Y","m/d/Y","dmY","mdY"),
    tz = "UTC"
  ))
  # si todos NA, intentar convertir texto->número->serial
  if (all(is.na(out))) {
    num <- suppressWarnings(parse_double(xx))
    out <- as.POSIXct(num * 86400, origin = "1899-12-30", tz = "UTC")
  }
  out
}

# 2) Convertir a numérico: vacíos/“NULL” -> NA, extrae número si hay unidades pegadas
to_num <- function(v) {
  v <- as.character(v)
  v[v == "" | tolower(v) == "null"] <- NA
  suppressWarnings(parse_number(v))
}

# 3) Detectar y eliminar una fila de “unidades” (ppm, ppb, µg/m3, etc.)
es_fila_unidades <- function(df_clean) {
  if (!"date" %in% names(df_clean)) return(FALSE)
  # mirar la PRIMERA(s) filas: si casi todas las columnas no-date son texto con letras -> unidades
  cand <- df_clean[1, setdiff(names(df_clean), "date"), drop = FALSE]
  vals <- unlist(cand, use.names = FALSE)
  vals <- as.character(vals)
  # cuenta cuántas celdas tienen letras (ppm, ppb, mmHg, kW/m2, °C, %)
  sum_letras <- sum(grepl("[A-Za-z°%µ/]", vals, perl = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
  sum_letras >= max(4, floor(0.5 * ncol(cand)))  # criterio sencillo y robusto
}

# ---------- Proceso por hoja (estación) ----------

procesar_hoja <- function(hoja) {
  # leo todo como TEXTO para controlar NAs y evitar warnings
  df <- read_excel(archivo_2025, sheet = hoja, col_types = "text") %>%
        clean_names()

  # si la fila 2 trae unidades (ppm, ppb...), la eliminamos
  if (nrow(df) > 0 && es_fila_unidades(df)) {
    df <- df[-1, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  # renombrar columnas según el mapa (solo las que existan)
  comunes <- intersect(names(df), names(map_names))
  names(df)[match(comunes, names(df))] <- map_names[comunes]

  # crear LOCATION
  df$LOCATION <- hoja

  # asegurar DATE
  if (!"DATE" %in% names(df)) df$DATE <- NA_character_

  # convertir numéricas (todas excepto LOCATION y DATE)
  num_cols <- setdiff(intersect(cols_final, names(df)), c("LOCATION","DATE"))
  df[num_cols] <- lapply(df[num_cols], to_num)

  # convertir DATE
  df$DATE <- parse_date_flex(df$DATE)

  # añadir columnas faltantes con NA
  faltantes <- setdiff(cols_final, names(df))
  for (c in faltantes) {
    if (c %in% c("LOCATION")) df[[c]] <- NA_character_ else
      if (c == "DATE") df[[c]] <- as.POSIXct(NA) else
        df[[c]] <- NA_real_
  }

  # mantener solo las columnas del esquema y en el orden correcto
  df_final <- df[, cols_final]

  # eliminar filas completamente vacías (todas numéricas NA y DATE NA)
  all_num <- setdiff(cols_final, c("LOCATION","DATE"))
  vacia <- is.na(df_final$DATE) & rowSums(!is.na(df_final[, all_num, drop = FALSE])) == 0
  df_final <- df_final[!vacia, ]

  df_final
}

# ---------- Ejecutar: todas las hojas de 2025 ----------
hojas <- excel_sheets(archivo_2025)
datos_2025 <- map_dfr(hojas, procesar_hoja) %>%
  arrange(LOCATION, DATE)

# ---------- Guardar ----------
write.csv(datos_2025, "2025.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Vista rápida
print(head(datos_2025))

```

# Limpieza 2024


```{r}


archivo_2024 <- "data/BD 2024.xlsx"

cols_final <- c("LOCATION","DATE","CO","NO","NO2","NOX","O3",
                "PM10","PM2.5","PRS","RAINF","RH","SO2",
                "SR","TOUT","WSR","WDR")

cols_excel <- c("Fecha y hora","CO (ppm)","NO (ppb)","NO2 (ppb)","NOX (ppb)",
                "O3 (ppb)","PM10 (ug/m3)","PM2.5 (ug/m3)","PRS (mmHg)",
                "RAINF (mm/h)","RH (%)","SO2 (ppb)","SR (kW/m2)",
                "TOUT (ºC)","WSR (km/h)","WDR (azimutal)")

procesar_hoja <- function(hoja) {
  df <- read_excel(archivo_2024, sheet = hoja,
                   col_names = cols_excel, skip = 1, col_types = "text")
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(LOCATION = hoja) %>%
    rename(
      DATE   = "Fecha y hora",
      CO     = "CO (ppm)",
      NO     = "NO (ppb)",
      NO2    = "NO2 (ppb)",
      NOX    = "NOX (ppb)",
      O3     = "O3 (ppb)",
      PM10   = "PM10 (ug/m3)",
      `PM2.5`= "PM2.5 (ug/m3)",
      PRS    = "PRS (mmHg)",
      RAINF  = "RAINF (mm/h)",
      RH     = "RH (%)",
      SO2    = "SO2 (ppb)",
      SR     = "SR (kW/m2)",
      TOUT   = "TOUT (ºC)",
      WSR    = "WSR (km/h)",
      WDR    = "WDR (azimutal)"
    )
  
  # convertir fecha
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(DATE = case_when(
      # si es número serial de Excel
      suppressWarnings(!is.na(as.numeric(DATE))) ~ as.POSIXct(as.numeric(DATE)*86400, origin = "1899-12-30", tz="UTC"),
      # si es texto en formato día/mes/año
      !is.na(dmy_hm(DATE, quiet = TRUE)) ~ dmy_hm(DATE, quiet = TRUE),
      # si es texto en formato mes/día/año
      !is.na(mdy_hm(DATE, quiet = TRUE)) ~ mdy_hm(DATE, quiet = TRUE),
      TRUE ~ NA
    ))
  
  # convertir las demás a numérico
  num_cols <- setdiff(cols_final, c("LOCATION","DATE"))
  df[num_cols] <- lapply(df[num_cols], function(x) {
    x[x == ""] <- NA
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  })
  
  df <- df[, cols_final]
  df
}

# procesar todas las hojas
hojas <- excel_sheets(archivo_2024)
datos_2024 <- map_dfr(hojas, procesar_hoja)

# guardar
write_csv(datos_2024, "2024.csv")


head(datos_2024, 40)

```

# Limpieza 2022 y 2023

```{r}
# 1) Archivo y hojas (excluye "CATÁLOGO", en el mismo orden del Excel)
archivo_2223 <- "data/BD 2022-2023.xlsx"
sheets_2223  <- setdiff(excel_sheets(archivo_2223), "CATÁLOGO")

# 2) Esquema final
cols_final <- c("LOCATION","DATE","CO","NO","NO2","NOX","O3",
                "PM10","PM2.5","PRS","RAINF","RH","SO2","SR","TOUT","WSR","WDR")

# 3) Helper fecha: serial de Excel o texto (d/m/Y o m/d/Y)
parse_date_safe <- function(x){
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  out <- rep(as.POSIXct(NA, tz="UTC"), length(x))
  m <- !is.na(num)
  if (any(m)) out[m] <- as.POSIXct(num[m]*86400, origin="1899-12-30", tz="UTC")
  if (any(!m)) {
    txt <- x[!m]
    d <- suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(
      txt,
      orders = c("d/m/Y H:M","d/m/Y H:M:S","m/d/Y H:M","m/d/Y H:M:S",
                 "Y-m-d H:M","Y-m-d H:M:S"),
      tz = "UTC"
    ))
    out[!m] <- d
  }
  out
}

# 4) Leer TODAS las hojas (sin saltar filas), "NULL" y "" → NA, tipos → numéricos
todo_2223 <- map_dfr(sheets_2223, function(sh){
  df <- read_excel(archivo_2223, sheet = sh, col_names = TRUE, col_types = "text",
                   na = c("NULL",""))  # <-- "NULL" y vacíos a NA

  # renombrar 'date' -> 'DATE' y crear LOCATION
  nms <- names(df); nms[tolower(nms) == "date"] <- "DATE"; names(df) <- nms
  df$LOCATION <- sh

  # DATE → POSIXct
  df$DATE <- parse_date_safe(df$DATE)

  # convertir todo (menos LOCATION/DATE) a numérico
  keep_non_numeric <- c("LOCATION","DATE")
  cols_num <- setdiff(intersect(names(df), cols_final), keep_non_numeric)
  df[cols_num] <- lapply(df[cols_num], function(v) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v)))

  # asegurar columnas del esquema y ordenarlas
  faltan <- setdiff(cols_final, names(df))
  for (c in faltan) {
    if (c == "LOCATION") df[[c]] <- NA_character_
    else if (c == "DATE") df[[c]] <- as.POSIXct(NA)
    else df[[c]] <- NA_real_
  }
  df <- df[, cols_final]

  # eliminar filas vacías (DATE NA y todo numérico NA)
  vacia <- is.na(df$DATE) & rowSums(!is.na(df[, setdiff(cols_final, c("LOCATION","DATE")), drop=FALSE])) == 0
  df[!vacia, ]
})

# 5) Separar por año y guardar
datos_2022 <- todo_2223 %>% filter(!is.na(DATE), year(DATE) == 2022) %>% arrange(LOCATION, DATE)
datos_2023 <- todo_2223 %>% filter(!is.na(DATE), year(DATE) == 2023) %>% arrange(LOCATION, DATE)

write_csv(datos_2022, "2022.csv")
write_csv(datos_2023, "2023.csv")
head(datos_2022)
```

# 2023 está incompleto, se usa otro dataset 

```{r}
# ================== LIMPIEZA BD 2023-2024 (formato por bloques) ==================
# Requisitos: readxl, dplyr, purrr, readr, lubridate
library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(purrr); library(readr); library(lubridate)

# ---- 0) Archivo de origen y salida
archivo_2023_2024 <- "data/BD 2023-2024.xlsx"     
salida_csv        <- "data/datos_2023_2024.csv"   
salida_rds        <- "data/datos_2023_2024.rds"

# ---- 1) Esquema objetivo
vars <- c("CO","NO","NO2","NOX","O3","PM10","PM2.5","PRS","RAINF","RH","SO2","SR","TOUT","WSR","WDR")
cols_final <- c("LOCATION","DATE", vars)

# ---- 2) Helpers
parse_date_flex <- function(x){
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  out <- rep(as.POSIXct(NA, tz="UTC"), length(x))
  m <- !is.na(num)
  if (any(m)) out[m] <- as.POSIXct(num[m]*86400, origin="1899-12-30", tz="UTC")
  if (any(!m)) {
    txt <- as.character(x[!m])
    d <- suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(
      txt,
      orders = c("d/m/Y H:M","d/m/Y H:M:S","m/d/Y H:M","m/d/Y H:M:S",
                 "Y-m-d H:M","Y-m-d H:M:S"),
      tz = "UTC"
    ))
    out[!m] <- d
  }
  out
}

to_num <- function(v){
  v <- trimws(as.character(v))
  v[v == "" | tolower(v) == "null"] <- NA
  suppressWarnings(readr::parse_number(v))
}

# ---- 3) Procesar UNA hoja con el formato: 
# Col A = date; Bloques de 15 vars (B:P) por estación; 1 col separadora vacía y se repite.
procesar_hoja_bloques <- function(archivo, hoja, sep_cols = 1){
  # Leer 2 filas de encabezado (1=estación, 2=unidades)
  hdr <- read_excel(archivo, sheet = hoja, col_names = FALSE, n_max = 2)
  est_row <- as.character(hdr[1, ])  # nombres de estación encima de cada bloque

  # Leer datos reales, saltando esas 2 filas
  raw <- read_excel(archivo, sheet = hoja, col_names = FALSE, skip = 2)

  # DATE (columna A) — se comparte para todos los bloques
  DATE <- parse_date_flex(raw[[1]])

  # Recorrer bloques desde la columna 2 en adelante
  n_cols    <- ncol(raw)
  block_sz  <- length(vars)   # 15
  col_idx   <- 2              # empieza en B
  out_list  <- list()

  while (col_idx + block_sz - 1 <= n_cols) {
    station <- est_row[[col_idx]]
    if (is.na(station) || station == "") station <- "UNKNOWN"

    cols_block <- col_idx:(col_idx + block_sz - 1)
    if (max(cols_block) > n_cols) break

    block_df <- as.data.frame(raw[, cols_block, drop = FALSE], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    names(block_df) <- vars
    block_df[] <- lapply(block_df, to_num)

    out <- tibble(LOCATION = station, DATE = DATE) %>% bind_cols(block_df)
    out_list[[length(out_list) + 1]] <- out

    col_idx <- col_idx + block_sz + sep_cols  # saltar separadora y continuar
  }

  bind_rows(out_list) %>%
    filter(!is.na(DATE)) %>%                 # quitar filas sin fecha
    select(all_of(cols_final)) %>%
    arrange(LOCATION, DATE)
}

# ---- 4) Procesar TODAS las hojas del archivo y unir
hojas <- excel_sheets(archivo_2023_2024)
datos_2023_2024 <- map_dfr(hojas, ~procesar_hoja_bloques(archivo_2023_2024, .x))

# ---- 5) Guardar resultados
write_csv(datos_2023_2024, salida_csv)
saveRDS(datos_2023_2024, salida_rds)

print(head(datos_2023_2024))
# str(datos_2023_2024)

```
